model.name: R20.22: Pinned Current Sprint = Sprint node with 3 tasks (current, last completed, next backlog), fully recursive children.
model.description: Refactor the pinned current task: the pin MUST be a Sprint-type node labeled 'Current Sprint' containing exactly 3 Task children: (1) CURRENT = the active WIP/focus task, (2) LAST COMPLETED = the most recently done task, (3) NEXT IN BACKLOG = the next queued task. Each of these 3 tasks FULLY RECURSIVELY loads its children in this special sprint node (the complete chain: req→UC→Class→Method→Impl→Test expands under each task). This replaces the single-task pin (R20.12) with a 3-task context window.

findings.summary: Planner SKILL.md (.claude/agents/robbin-planner/SKILL.md) has ZERO references to 3-slot driving verbs (focus/setNextBacklog/clearNextBacklog/hop/gate/getThreeSlots/CurrentSprint). The aligned skill doc lives in scrum.pmo/skills/planner-current-sprint-driving.md (commit b8b1f685a) but agents read .claude/agents/ at boot. The planner boots without knowledge of the 3-slot API.
findings.fix: Merge scrum.pmo/skills/planner-current-sprint-driving.md content into .claude/agents/robbin-planner/SKILL.md § CurrentSprint Driving, or symlink.

findings.summary: CurrentSprint.ts HOP_OWNERS maps method→expert. But the locked chain says method = architect (UC.method is the architect-designed singular method). The expert implements the impl, not the method scenario unit. method hop should be owner=architect, impl hop=expert.
findings.fix: Change HOP_OWNERS.method from "expert" to "architect" in CurrentSprint.ts:24-27.

findings.summary: getThreeSlots derives lastCompleted as completed[completed.length-1] — the last task in iteration order that is NOT focused. But iteration order of index.list() is UUID-prefix shard order, NOT chronological. Two tasks with adjacent UUID prefixes will appear adjacent regardless of when they completed. Should use updatedAt or a completion timestamp.
findings.fix: Sort completed array by updatedAt descending before picking [0]. Or add a completedAt field set on advance().

findings.summary: nextBacklog auto-derives from tasks.filter(t => !t.focus && t.reqUuid && !t.hasUcChain) — "first task without UC chain." But tasks in QA Review or Done status should NOT be backlog candidates. No status filter.
findings.fix: Add status filter: exclude tasks where status is "QA Review" or "Done".

findings.summary: The /api/trace/children CurrentSprint handler (server.ts:700-719) builds 3 slot children with status labels (GATE-PROVEN/IMPL-DONE/IN-PROGRESS). This is consistent with getThreeSlots. No gap here — just noting alignment is correct.

architectConsistencyReview.verdict: F1 is the critical gap — planner boots without 3-slot knowledge. F2 is a semantic correctness issue. F3/F4 are edge-case accuracy. Code logic (getThreeSlots + CurrentSprint + server endpoint) is internally consistent; the gap is skill-doc propagation.
